free_tier.stated: Quoted: 'Get started free of charge with CHF 300.- credits to be used within 3 months.' The credits are once per customer and restricted to 35 named countries, and a card with a CHF 20 preauthorisation is required to take them.

per_object_cap.stated: once per customer: 'this offer is available in the following countries ... once per customer'

retention.stated: the credits expire: 'CHF 300 of credits for the Public Cloud product for 3 months'. Instances bill by the hour on the median of the hour's use; storage is separate and 10 TB a month of outgoing traffic is included per organisation.

egress.terms: Quoted: 'the incoming and outgoing traffic is free. With regard to storage, 10 TB are included per month and per organisation for outgoing traffic (the rate indicated on this page then applies).'

interface_detail: OpenStack Nova instances with SSH, a console and an OpenStack API; block storage on Ceph/Cinder
tooling: any SSH client; the OpenStack CLI or the vendor console
chaining: A Swiss OpenStack cloud with real VM shapes and 10 TB a month of egress, but the CHF 20 hold is exactly the pattern the operator objects to, and it is restricted to 35 countries.
